entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: A hydra-god of Naya, origin and sustainer of life, who slumbers in the Valley of the Ancient and awakens when the planes merge.

entities.name: Mayael the Anima
entities.description: A young elf chosen as the Anima of the Cylian elves, who discerns Progenitus' will after undergoing the Whitecover Gaze.

entities.name: Cylia
entities.description: The first Anima, a shaman's youngest daughter who wounded Progenitus with a poisoned dagger in Mayael's vision.

entities.name: Cylian elves
entities.description: Naya's elves who monitor the Valley of the Ancient and devote themselves to Progenitus.

entities.name: Godtrackers
entities.description: Elite elf warriors who track gargantuans and report to Mayael.

entities.name: Epicists
entities.description: Elves who write oral epics recording the gargantuans' behavior.

entities.name: Valley Wards
entities.description: Elves in treetop camps who monitor Progenitus' breathing and communicate by wooden pipes.

entities.name: Gargantuans
entities.description: Behemoth creatures of Naya seen by the elves as expressions of Progenitus' will.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara, a jungle paradise home to the Cylian elves.

entities.name: Valley of the Ancient
entities.description: A jungle valley in Naya where Progenitus slumbers.

entities.name: Sacellum
entities.description: A temple crafted from living jungle trees.

entities.name: Whitecover Gaze
entities.description: The ritual that clouds the Anima's eyes pearl-white and reveals the depth of the world.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The merging of Alara's shards that brings blue and black mana back into Naya.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose shards are merging.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose castles intrude on Naya.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose tar pits intrude on Naya.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose necropolises blast into Jund volcanoes.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose dark seas seep into Bant.

events.summary: The previous Anima names Mayael her successor in the Sacellum.
events.quote: Near death, the Anima named Mayael as her successor

events.summary: Mayael undergoes the Whitecover Gaze and receives the memories of all the Anima.
events.quote: As her sight leaked from her eyes, her mind surged with the memories of all the Anima

events.summary: In Mayael's vision, Progenitus unleashes five storms to consume creation.
events.quote: Progenitus had become displeased with creation and unleashed five storms to consume it

events.summary: Cylia begs Progenitus for mercy and he blinds her.
events.quote: Furious at her impudence, Progenitus blinded the young girl

events.summary: Cylia stabs Progenitus' mystical connection with a poisoned dagger, forcing him into a five-headed hydra form, wounded and dormant.
events.quote: With that one blow, Progenitus' divine essence scattered and his earthly body formed: a five-headed hydra.

events.summary: The Conflux merges the shards and Bant castles and Jund tar pits intrude on Naya; Mayael is powerless to stop it.
events.quote: By the time Bant castles and Jund tar pits intruded in her verdant paradise, Mayael was powerless to stop it.

events.summary: Mayael rallies her army of elves and gargantuans to hold borders that no longer exist.
events.quote: Mayael rallied her army of elves and gargantuans and try to hold borders that no longer existed.

events.summary: Black and blue mana stir the withered heads of Progenitus, who bursts from his tomb in the Valley of the Ancient.
events.quote: His earthly tomb now open, Progenitus arched into the sky.

events.summary: Mayael perceives that the Anima's task is complete and regards Progenitus as the world made flesh.
events.quote: He is the world made flesh.

relations.quote: before she could lead the elves

relations.note: devote their lives to the hydra-god
relations.quote: Many elves devote their lives to the hydra, doing whatever they can to understand his will and keep him at peace.

relations.note: wounded him with a poisoned dagger
relations.quote: she flung her poisoned dagger straight into its ethereal heart
They report back regularly to Mayael.
Buried under centuries of jungle growth, something slumbers in the Valley of the Ancient.
